issue.title: sq-7d3dj.30.18: perf(engine): hoist rhs scans/builds across seed blocks in eval_bgp_binary_capped
issue.body:
sq-7d3dj.30.8 v1 re-derives the GOO chain per seed block, so each non-bind step re-runs its rhs scan_to_bindings (and hash build) per block — bounded at ~3x by the three-block schedule (1024/64k/rest), paid only by ASK-false / LIMIT-miss queries. Hoist: derive the step order once, materialise each step's rhs once, reuse across blocks (hash tables reusable if build side is pinned to rhs — order-relaxed is fine, the capped contract is multiset-level). Composes with the stream_pipeline block driver design (research/lazy-pull-incremental-emission.md, sq-7d3dj.34.2.3) — consider sharing that machinery instead of a private hoist.

<!-- bd-id:sq-7d3dj.30.18 -->
Parent: #2588

head_commit.message:
fix(ci): identify unknown area labels before triage writes (#6473)

* fix(ci): identify unknown area rows before classification writes

Route triage-area titles to the CI lane and report escaped issue, missing-label and tier records before the unchanged global write barrier. Preserve separate reviewed provisioning for real existing crates and never create labels from the classifier.

Co-Authored-By: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* fix(ci): clarify fetched-label diagnostics and pin rule ordering

Keep unknown labels fail-closed while requiring exact lookup before reviewed provisioning. Cover title collisions, dry-run failures, escaped workflow lines and full-suite anchor metadata controls.

Co-Authored-By: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>
